description: Find gyms and studios (CrossFit, HYROX, fitness, yoga, pilates, boxing, martial arts, dance, climbing) in France and Europe, near a point or by name, city or postcode. Activity words in the query filter ('CrossFit Nice', 'yoga Lyon'); a style word (bikram, vinyasa, hatha, yin, reformer, lagree) stays on that discipline and is returned in styles. The rest is the place or the gym name. bookable: true means the gym can be booked: url is its public booking page and bookingUrl is that page with marketplace attribution. bookable: false means do not offer booking: url is the directory listing (claimed but not ready, or not on Gymmy). Gyms not on Gymmy come from OpenStreetMap and other public sources (each with its source page and date), with address, opening hours, the gym's own booking link and prices when read on its website (each with its source and date, not verified by Gymmy), and a claim link. Use the `gym` value with get_gym, get_schedule, get_prices or start_trial only when bookable is true. Each gym includes, when Gymmy has it: full address, city, country, coordinates (geo), mapsUrl (Google Maps), directionsUrl, appleMapsUrl, logoUrl (the salle logo or a sourced photo, null when there is none), listingUrl (public page, null when the gym is not public), phone, public email, website and opening hours. Never invent a logo or an address. gym, classId and memberId are internal ids for your next tool call. Never show them to the user. Call get_my_account for who is signed in (name, email, member id, gyms).

activity.description: Only this activity (studios not on Gymmy). Read from the query when it names one.

locale.description: Answer language: fr (default), en, pt, es or de. Pass en when the person writes in English.

query.description: Gym name, address, district, city or postcode, optionally with an activity, e.g. 'Lyon', 'CrossFit Nice', 'yoga Lyon', '12 rue Oberkampf Paris' or 'The Wolf Pack'. Places are geocoded when no lat/lng is given.

radius_km.description: Radius in km, 1 to 50. Default: 10, or fitted to the geocoded place (3 for an address).

style.description: Only this yoga or pilates style (bikram, vinyasa, hatha, yin, hot, reformer, lagree, …). Read from the query when it names one. The discipline stays in activities.

name: search_gyms

items.description: A gym. `gym` is the internal id for the next tool call. Do not show it to the user.

address.description: Full postal address (street, postcode, city, country). Null when unknown.

appleMapsUrl.description: Apple Maps URL for the same place.

country.description: Country, ISO alpha-2 when the gym stored one (FR, PT…).

directionsUrl.description: Google Maps directions URL to the gym.

email.description: Public contact email of the gym. Not a member email.

listingUrl.description: Public listing or published gym page. Null when the gym is not public.

logoUrl.description: Salle logo or sourced photo. Null when the gym has none. Never invent one.

mapsUrl.description: Google Maps search URL built from coordinates, or from the address.

openingHours.description: Opening hours in one line, when known.

phone.description: Public phone. Null when the gym has not published one.

styles.description: Yoga or pilates style ids (bikram, vinyasa, hatha, yin, reformer, lagree, …). The discipline stays in activities.

title: Search gyms and studios
